extracted.intended_audience: Authors and editors of Cochrane systematic reviews (review teams preparing Cochrane intervention reviews)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for preparing and maintaining Cochrane systematic reviews of healthcare interventions, covering standard methods applicable to every review and specialised topics. Also collates core methodological expectations (MECIR) that are generally expected of Cochrane reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Planning a review
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on the standard methods applicable to every review, including planning a review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Handbook includes guidance on the standard methods applicable to every review (planning a review ...). All authors should consult the Handbook for guidance on the methods used in Cochrane systematic reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Methodological Expectations for Cochrane Intervention Reviews (MECIR) — core standards
rubrics_metrics.description: A collation of key aspects of Handbook guidance presented as core standards that are generally expected of Cochrane reviews.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Key aspects of Handbook guidance are collated as the Methodological Expectations for Cochrane Intervention Reviews (MECIR). These provide core standards that are generally expected of Cochrane reviews. Each MECIR item includes a link to a relevant Handbook chapter.
